tagline: Kwandege Street's cellar for wine, whisky, and everything worth raising a glass to.
address: Tipsy District, Kwandege Street, Nairobi, Kenya
about: Tipsy District started as a corner shelf and grew into the neighbourhood's go-to cellar. We stock what we'd actually pour ourselves — small-batch spirits, dependable everyday wines, and the odd bottle you won't find on every other shelf in Nairobi. No pretence, just good bottles and people who know what's in them.
delivery: We deliver across Nairobi within 60–90 minutes of your order. Within 3km of Kwandege Street delivery is KSh 150; further out it's calculated on WhatsApp before you confirm. Walk-ins and pickups are always welcome — just message us your order and a rough arrival time.
